N27_legitimate_root_range.statement: For N=27 every legitimate nonempty root has r0<=12.
proof: Nonempty gives m0>=1 and full coverage gives L0>=r0.

high_r_degree1_corridor.statement: For every legitimate N=27 root with r0>=9, a degree-1 live variable exists.
proof: Every live variable occurs at least once. If every live variable occurred at least twice then L0>=2*r0, contradiction.
Therefore some live variable occurs exactly once.

degree1_elimination_reroot.statement: At a unit-free ordinary stage, eliminating a degree-1 pivot creates no resolvents and reduces local input-size units by at least four, hence for N=27 the residual local size N'<=23.
proof: A degree-1 pivot occurs in exactly one clause and one polarity, so one resolution bucket is empty and no resolvent is generated.
Deleting that clause removes one clause unit, at least two literal units because the stage is unit-free, and at least the pivot variable itself.

cap_monotonicity.statement: The inherited N'<=24 theorem proves ordinary availability under the smaller local cap (N')^2. Since N'<=23 and the frozen run retains the original cap 27^2=729, all inherited certified steps remain available.

theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N27
theorem.statement: For N<=26 inherit the proved corridor. At N=27, roots with r0<=8 are certified directly by the existing exact T/Smax/Uraw recurrence; roots with r0 in {9,10,11,12} necessarily contain a degree-1 pivot. Eliminating that pivot creates no resolvents and re-roots the residual at local size at most 23, inside the already-proved N<=24 corridor. Therefore v2/v3 cannot be required because of ordinary raw-cap unavailability for any legitimate root with N<=27.

next_exact_target: Advance the frozen-grammar frontier to N=28 using the same exact recurrence plus legitimate-root and degree-1 reroot invariants. Do not alter grammar unless an actual reachable current-grammar gap is established.
